lines.say: After replication, a chromosome is two identical sister chromatids joined at a centromere.

draw.alt: Unreplicated chromosome becomes two sister chromatids at a centromere

lines.say: Human body cells are diploid: 46 chromosomes in 23 homologous pairs.
Homologues carry the same genes, but may carry different alleles.
Count chromosomes by centromeres. S phase doubles DNA from 2 c to 4 c.

frames.heading: The cell cycle and its brakes

lines.say: Interphase is G1, S and G2. Then comes M phase.

draw.alt: Cell cycle phases in a row

lines.say: Cyclins are the seasons. CDKs are the engine that only runs when cyclin arrives.
Cyclin levels rise and fall. CDK levels stay the same.
Checkpoints at G1, G2 to M, and the spindle pause the cycle if something's wrong.
p53 is the guardian. It switches on p21 to stop the cycle, or triggers apoptosis.
Prophase: chromosomes condense and the spindle starts forming.
Prometaphase: the nuclear envelope breaks down and microtubules grab the kinetochores.
Metaphase: chromosomes line up in the middle.

draw.alt: Chromosomes lined up on metaphase plate

lines.say: Anaphase: cohesin is cut, and sister chromatids move away to opposite poles.

draw.alt: Sister chromatids pulled to opposite poles

lines.say: Telophase: nuclei reform. Then cytokinesis: a furrow in animals, a cell plate in plants.
Result: two identical diploid cells.
Meiosis is one replication, then two divisions. Four haploid, different cells.
Prophase one: homologues pair up and cross over at chiasmata.
Anaphase one: the partners separate. The chromosome number halves here.

draw.alt: Homologous pair separating in meiosis I

lines.say: Meiosis two separates the twins, the sister chromatids. Just like mitosis.
For 2 n equals 8: after meiosis one, 4 chromosomes and 2 c. After meiosis two, 4 and 1 c.
Cross, shuffle, meet. Crossing over happens in prophase one.
Shuffle: each bivalent lines up at random. For humans, 2 to the 23 is about 8.4 million.
Meet: any sperm can fertilise any egg.
Non-disjunction in meiosis one makes all four gametes abnormal.
lines.write: MI error: n+1, n+1, n−1, n−1

draw.alt: Four abnormal gametes after meiosis I non-disjunction

lines.say: In meiosis two, only one cell is affected, so two gametes are normal.
The number halves in meiosis one, not meiosis two.
Crossing over is in prophase one, not metaphase.
Prophase, metaphase in the middle, anaphase away, telophase.
p53 is the guardian. Rb is the gatekeeper into S phase.
